text: Outside the Application Office, a flamboyantly dressed figure appeared. She peered inside through the glass and looked up several times, seemingly confirming the sign by the door.
Your gaze is drawn to the hesitant figure, and just as you consider going out to meet her, the doorbell finally rings.
As you press the door open switch, a cheerful voice comes from the entrance.
Hello! So this is the Application Office, meow?
Yes, this is the place.
As she approaches the window, a rich floral scent wafts over first. You twitch your nose. The perfume is definitely excessive for a cat.
But the irritation that had just welled up in your heart quickly subsided thanks to her lively yet polite tone.
Sorry about that, meow. The exterior here is more modest than I imagined. I got lost outside a few times.
But I guess I'm not familiar enough with the streets either, meow.
You look up and meet her gaze. Her meticulously groomed, fluffy fur complements her gorgeous outfit, and her heterochromatic eyes are quite rare. You take a second look.
She seems accustomed to being stared at, squinting her eyes and offering a smile.
I can tell you're not the kind of person one sees everywhere on the streets. You probably didn't have to do everything yourself before.
This seems to hit a chord with her, making her ears twitch happily and the corners of her mouth and whiskers lift slightly.
Finally, someone noticed! I thought my popularity had dropped that much!
Sorry, what popularity are you referring to?
Oh, well, it seems you don't know me either. I'm an idol. Or, I was.
Anyway, here are my documents. Please take them, meow~
Her moods come and go quickly, somewhat deliberate and exaggerated.
Puzzled, you accept her file.
Is there anything you want to ask?
As a cat, you carry a banana with you? It's a rather unique choice for an accessory.
Of course not! This is a gift from my fans, expressing their love for me.
Even if it clashes a bit with my style, I still cherish it.
So your fans are... monkeys?
You try to imagine a troop of monkeys surrounding a cat, cheering and supporting her. It's quite difficult.
Seeing you hesitate to speak, Felicia doesn't seem offended.
Like you said, I'm unusual, meow.
She winks. You think, she really is a professional idol.
Orgy?
Wipe that surprised look off your face.
Sorry, it's just that this seems rather disconnected from your image.
That's slander! A blatant smear on my image!
For the first time, Felicia shows a gloomy expression, her emotions devoid of performance. But your colleagues wouldn't make a mistake on such a serious charge.
A smear? This is a solid criminal record.
Enough! You don't know the truth! Those fans... they just loved me so much that they wanted to know about and participate in my private life too.
It was just an unofficial fan meeting. That's all, meow.
That doesn't sound very believable.
Whatever you're imagining, you have no basis for it!
You still want to...
If there's nothing else, I'm leaving.
Let me remind you, if I find out you're spreading rumors, my lawyer will take action.
Maybe she's really angry, or maybe there's more to this story.
But in any case, Felicia is already just an angry retreating figure. You withdraw your gaze and suppress your curiosity for now.
